state:
**Goal `goal-closeout`, Stage 4 (finished in place).** Six of `nvs-runtime`'s ten goal-owned gaps are closed. The newest is `a-call-on-a-value-that-is-not-a-closure-is-an-internal-error`. A compiled `$f(...)` whose callee is not a closure now throws a catchable `LogicError` naming what it is (`require_closure` in the closure call path), and `rule:types/callable-is-a-closure` states it. The hostile attack `03-values-that-are-not-functions-are-called.nvs` passes without its marker, and a conformance case pins every message.

The floor check `the latest CI run on main succeeded for the code HEAD holds` is red only because `main` is ahead of `origin/main`, and the loop never pushes. A person has to push.

`bun nv owners --closes goal-closeout` names 46 gaps, in `nvs-lsp`, `nvs-runtime` (four), `nvs-stdlib`, `nvs-types`, `editors/vscode` and `website`.

items.text: **The other four `nvs-runtime` gaps, built or struck as stated bounds** — `enum-case-that-reached-a-mixed` (`crates/nvs-runtime/src/lib.rs:1`, needs an ADR, so strike it as a bound or defer it to a milestone), `a-core-call-with-a-large-string-costs-time-per-byte` (`crates/nvs-runtime/src/lib.rs:1`), `the-peak-update-cost-is-argued-and-never-measured` (`crates/nvs-runtime/src/budget.rs:155`), and `the-peak-histogram-and-the-high-water-warn-are-unbuilt` (`crates/nvs-runtime/src/metrics.rs:188`).

backlog: `nvs-stdlib`'s goal-owned gaps (`bun nv owners --closes goal-closeout`), then `nvs-types`, `nvs-lsp`, `editors/vscode` and `website`.
